title: Internal Hom from a locally finite free internal module preserves small colimits
statement: Let X be a scheme, R a commutative ring object in abelian sheaves on its pro-etale site, and P an internal R-module. If a pro-etale covering of X makes P finite free after ordinary pullback, then the actual internal Hom functor Mod.ihom P preserves every (u+1)-small colimit. No noetherianity or coefficient-field assumption is required.

source.place: Original declaration docstring, expanded geometric argument steps 1--7, following Hemo--Richarz--Scholbach 5.3(2)

proof.text: Identify weakly etale pullback with restriction of sheaves on the localized site, compatibly with the monoidal structures. Restriction commutes with sheaf internal Hom. The right adjoints of module tensor are uniquely isomorphic, so the comparison for internal module Hom is invertible.

source.place: Original declaration docstring, expanded geometric argument steps 1--7, following Hemo--Richarz--Scholbach 5.3(2)

proof.text: Pullbacks of sheaves along a pro-etale covering jointly reflect isomorphisms, by checking at the base changes of each site object. The same holds for module objects by their forgetful functor.

source.place: Original declaration docstring, expanded geometric argument steps 1--7, following Hemo--Richarz--Scholbach 5.3(2)

proof.text: For a finite free module, internal Hom is naturally a finite power of the identity, hence a finite coproduct. These functors preserve all small colimits. The module forgetful functor creates colimits, so pullback on module objects also preserves colimits.

source.place: Original declaration docstring, expanded geometric argument steps 1--7, following Hemo--Richarz--Scholbach 5.3(2)

proof.text: Pull back the canonical colimit comparison to each trivializing member. Naturality of the internal Hom isomorphism makes it a comparison for a finite power and hence an isomorphism. Joint reflection gives the original comparison. This includes rank zero.

lean.statement:
theorem condensed_locally_free_ihom_preservesColimits {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (R : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) [MonObj R] [IsCommMonObj R]
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) R)
    (hP : ∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ s : C.I₀,
      Mod.IsFree ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).obj R)
        (((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).mapMod R).obj P)) :
    PreservesColimitsOfSize.{u + 1, u + 1} (Mod.ihom P)
